ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited demonstrated robust Q2FY27 results, exhibiting strong year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by its vertically integrated elevator and stainless steel divisions. Key takeaways include successful market penetration for new home lift products and enhanced manufacturing efficiency from recent capital investments, positioning the company to capitalize on significant industry tailwinds. However, a material increase in "Other Assets" on the balance sheet alongside rising borrowings warrants closer examination to understand potential working capital implications.
